listing.name: Legacy of Kain: Soul Reaver / Alexbeav PSXRecomp
listing.summary: Explore Legacy of Kain: Soul Reaver / Alexbeav PSXRecomp and follow the upstream project for requirements, downloads and setup.

steps.title: Prepare the game with upstream setup
steps.instruction: This download is an upstream setup package. It prepares the game from your own matching disc through the upstream launcher’s generation/build step. Downloading does not run that step.

steps.title: Supply only the files the upstream guide requires
steps.instruction: Open the linked setup guide for this release. Use your own matching disc and its tracks; supply a BIOS only when that guide requires it. Complete the supported generation/build step in upstream’s launcher, then return to Portcove.

steps.title: Confirm the game or launcher
steps.instruction: Choose the resulting native game executable or its supported upstream launcher to finish adding the game. If setup installed elsewhere, choose that location. Adding it saves launch details; Play starts it separately. You or upstream manage runtime updates, original files, saves and settings; these external files are outside Portcove backups.
